business_summary: TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, development, and ownership of guest houses, hotels, and restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Wedding Business, Hotel Business, and Wellness and Relaxation Business. The company plans, operates, and provides wedding, banquet, and accommodation services, as well as guest house, hotel, resort, photo and outsourced wedding services; and operates The Strings Hotel Nagoya and Kimpton Shinjuku Tokyo hotel brands. It also manages and operates hotels and restaurants under the Hotel InterContinental Tokyo Bay, The Strings Hotel Tokyo InterContinental, and The Strings Hotel Tokyo Bay names; operates reflexology salon under the Queensway name; hot spring facility under Miraku Onsen SPA-HERBS name; and fitness club under the BEST STYLE name, as well as a body care salon under the GINZA BODY CARE name. In addition, the company provides food and beverage and services for wedding receptions, wedding costumes and beauty services, such as hair and make-up and bridal beauty care, wedding planning, photography and videography, flower arrangements, MCs, sound systems, and other services; and operates local wedding venues in Hawaii, USA, and Bali, as well as conducts wedding ceremonies and receptions. Further, the company engages in weddings planning, hotel management and outsourcing, and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Best Bridal Inc. and changed its name to TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc. in July 2014. TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Minato, Japan.
business_summary_ko: TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc.는 자회사를 통해 일본 및 해외의 게스트하우스, 호텔, 레스토랑의 계획, 개발 및 소유에 참여하고 있습니다. 웨딩 사업, 호텔 사업, 웰니스 및 휴식 사업의 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 웨딩, 연회, 숙박 서비스와 게스트하우스, 호텔, 리조트, 포토, 웨딩 위탁 서비스를 기획, 운영, 제공하는 회사입니다. The Strings Hotel Nagoya 및 Kimpton Shinjuku Tokyo 호텔 브랜드를 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 Hotel InterContinental Tokyo Bay, The Strings Hotel Tokyo InterContinental 및 The Strings Hotel Tokyo Bay 이름으로 호텔과 레스토랑을 관리하고 운영합니다. Queensway라는 이름으로 반사 요법 살롱을 운영합니다. 미라쿠 온천 SPA-HERBS라는 이름의 온천 시설; BEST STYLE이라는 이름의 피트니스 클럽과 GINZA BODY CARE라는 이름의 바디 케어 살롱이 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 헤어 및 메이크업, 신부 뷰티 케어, 웨딩 플래닝, 사진 및 영상 촬영, 꽃꽂이, MC, 음향 시스템, 기타 서비스 등 결혼식 피로연, 웨딩 의상 및 뷰티 서비스를 위한 식음료 및 서비스를 제공합니다.
